drainLeftoverToken(address,address).details: This function can only be called by the contract itself, typically as part of a multicall.      It delegates the draining logic to `_drainRemainingToken`.

params.destination: The address to send the drained tokens to.
params.token: The address of the token to drain. If `address(0)`, native tokens (ETH) will be drained.

withdrawAllWETH(address).details: This function can only be called by the contract itself. It retrieves the contract's entire      WETH balance, unwraps it to ETH, and then transfers all the ETH to the `recipient`.

params.recipient: The address to which all unwrapped Ether will be sent.

withdrawWETH(address,uint256).details: This function can only be called by the contract itself. It first unwraps WETH to ETH      and then transfers the ETH to the `recipient`.

params.amount: The amount of WETH to withdraw and convert to Ether.
params.recipient: The address to which the unwrapped Ether will be sent.

drainLeftoverToken(address,address).notice: Drains a single leftover token from this contract to a specified destination.

withdrawAllWETH(address).notice: Withdraws all WETH (Wrapped Ether) held by this contract and sends the corresponding Ether to a recipient.

withdrawWETH(address,uint256).notice: Withdraws a specified amount of WETH (Wrapped Ether) and sends the corresponding Ether to a recipient.
